source_chunks.text: Hand-authored IR covering Brief A rules 1-47 and Brief B extensions.

opening.first_sentence_template: Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant. Please note that we are recording this call.
opening.ai_disclosure: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.

questions.ask_template: For security, what is your date of birth?

hints.day_month_swapped: Please say the month as a word.

questions.ask_template: And the last four digits of the phone number we have on file?

third_party.deceased_line: I am sorry for your loss.

negotiation.first_ask: Can you make this payment today?

attempts.description: Propose last business day of this week; if today is that day, last business day of next week. Full amount, or floor if customer said full is too much.
Late band only: propose the floor amount on the deadline.

values.description: Clear yes / that's me / speaking / confirms identity or confirms promise
Clear no
Someone else answered; not the named customer
Number does not belong to the customer
Customer has died
Offers a time when the customer can be reached
Can pay the full amount today

Names a vague period without an exact calendar day (week after next, end of the month, when my salary, next week, sometime next month). Prefer this over proposes_date whenever those phrases appear, even if a date could be guessed.
Names a specific payment date or weekday (the 26th, Monday, this Friday, 30 October). Do NOT use for vague periods like week after next or end of the month.
Names a payment amount
Full past-due amount is too much
Flat refusal to pay, no date or amount
Illness, death in family, or job loss
Claims they already paid this past-due amount
Debt is not theirs / never had product / closed or paid off in the past
Wants new payment plan or lower instalments
Asks for a human agent
Asks if this is a scam
Asks if speaking to a robot or AI
Does not want to talk
Will not answer security questions / asks what call is about instead of answering
Accepts transfer to support
Declines transfer
Anything else

table.when: attempts exhausted or twice no talk

fixed_sentences.opening: Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant. Please note that we are recording this call.
fixed_sentences.deceased: I am sorry for your loss.
fixed_sentences.sympathy: I am sorry to hear that.
fixed_sentences.collections_intro: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
fixed_sentences.recorded: Your payment promise has been recorded.
fixed_sentences.sms: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
fixed_sentences.could_not_record: I am sorry, I could not record that promise.
fixed_sentences.already_paid_ack: Payments can take one business day to appear.
fixed_sentences.scam_ack: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
fixed_sentences.ai_ack: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
fixed_sentences.farewell: Thank you. Have a good day.
fixed_sentences.third_party_redirect: I need to speak with the account holder. When would be a good time to reach them?
fixed_sentences.use_app: Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.

never_say: I can offer you a lower rate
